单驱出入沙地布超16布

小超传递布，若有大超覆盖质驱则自动关闭，不建议拆除。

建议整合到单质驱入。

Single Mass Driver In/Out ODD 16-Phase Sand

Small overdrive projectors relay overdrive coverage across the phase conveyors.
If a overdrive dome covers the Mass Driver, the overdrive projector will automatically disable.
Removing it is not recommended.

Recommended for integration with a single Mass Driver input setup.
